0x0000.name: pair_stop_marker_0000
0x0000.notes: Seen only in POST .../pair when exiting/disabling pairing; likely stop/cancel companion marker

0x0007.name: client_nonce
0x0007.notes: Client nonce used in auth/token flow

0x007a.name: orientation_or_overlay_state
0x007a.notes: Seen in /sen; toggles with orientation/dial overlay

0x0104.name: pair_action
0x0104.notes: Pairing transaction marker in POST .../pair; present on both start and stop

0x01a0.name: fw_state_status
0x01a0.notes: Firmware state/status byte seen in d/<dev>/fw.state. Observed: 0x07 immediately before an update sequence; 0x08 when device is on normal/steady state after update.

0x0039.name: fw_version_target_or_reported
0x0039.notes: Second firmware version field in fw.state. Often matches 0x003A after update; can be 0x0000 before update. Likely 'target/expected' or 'reported-to-cloud' firmware version.

0x0035.name: fw_version_other_slot
0x0035.notes: Firmware version present in the other/inactive external SPI slot (or previous version).

0x003b.name: fw_state_phase_or_step
0x003b.notes: Small state/phase value in fw.state. Observed values: 0x0E (older state) and 0x06 (post-update). Likely update/bootloader phase indicator.

0x0036.name: fw_state_aux_0036
0x0036.notes: Auxiliary fw.state byte. Observed: VA/RU show 0x0A; IB shows 0x00. Possibly device-family, channel, or partition indicator. Needs more samples correlated with device type.

0x003c.name: fw_state_phase_aux_003c
0x003c.notes: Second small state/phase value in fw.state. Observed values track 0x003B in samples (e.g., 0x0E or 0x06). Likely additional phase/health indicator for the update state machine.

0x0180.name: fw_state_update_result_or_bootcount
0x0180.notes: fw.state flag that changed across an update in observed VA: 0x00 before update, 0x04 after update. Likely update result/status, applied-update marker, or boot counter/flags.

0x012d.name: temperature_ambient
0x012d.notes: Primary ambient temperature (°C×100). | Seen in: d/RU*/sen, d/VA*/sen | Len: 2 bytes | u16 values around 1600–1900 consistent with temperature in centi-degrees (°C×100).

0x012e.name: aux_temperature_1
0x012e.notes: Secondary temperature (°C×100). | Seen in: d/RU*/sen, d/VA*/sen | Len: 2 bytes | u16 values around 1600–1900 consistent with temperature in centi-degrees (°C×100).

0x0135.name: humidity_percent
0x0135.notes: Relative humidity (%×10). | Seen in: d/RU*/sen, d/VA*/sen | Len: 2 bytes | u16 values around 450–560 consistent with humidity ×10 (%RH).

0x0136.name: ambient_light_level
0x0136.notes: Ambient light level (unitless). | Seen in: d/RU*/sen, d/VA*/sen | Len: 1 bytes | u8 values 0–70-ish; likely ambient light 'level'.

0x0137.name: dial_encoder_steps
0x0137.notes: Dial encoder A/B state bitfield (0..3 typical). | Seen in: d/RU*/sen, d/VA*/sen | Observed values: 0, 3 | Len: 1 bytes | u8 values 0–3-ish; likely dial encoder A/B state bitfield.

0x0158.name: device_ui_flags_0158
0x0158.notes: Config flags; observed dazzle mode toggle changes 0x0158 between 0x0000 (off) and 0x0200 (on).

0x015c.name: home_id
0x015c.notes: Paired home id stored on device

0x015d.name: device_type
0x015d.notes: Device type identifier: RU = 71, VA Horizontal = 112, VA Vertical = 113

0x0160.name: device_reset_reason
0x0160.notes: Hardware reset reason flags (STM32 RCC CSR flags: 1=PIN, 2=POR/PDR, 4=Software, 8=IWDG, 16=WWDG, 32=LPWR)

0x0161.name: hvac_link_status_flags
0x0161.notes: HVAC and Room Unit link/communication status flags (Bit 15 = DHW/Burner Active, Bit 14 = OT Link Online, Bits 0-7 = Contiki communication error codes)

0x0162.name: battery_mv
0x0162.notes: Battery voltage in millivolts. | Seen in: d/RU*/sen, d/VA*/sen | Len: 2 bytes

0x0168.name: ru_opentherm_selftest_supply_mv
0x0168.notes: RU selftest metric seen in d/RU*/selftest/result. Value ~2900-3130 (mV), likely OT/docked subsystem supply/reference rail health check; not tied to heat demand.

0x0182.name: fallback_active
0x0182.notes: Active status for device fallback mode

0x01a8.name: fw_offer_marker_a8
0x01a8.notes: Seen in d/fw with zero length.

0x01a3.name: error_flags_u32
0x01a3.notes: Observed 0x00004000 for VA when unmounted, 0x00000000 when mounted. Likely bit14=mount/contact fault.

0x01fb.name: va_mount_flags
0x01fb.notes: Actuator mounting process execution status flags

0x01fc.name: pairing_mode
0x01fc.notes: IB pairing mode toggle; 01 enables pairing mode, 00 disables

0x0201.name: pair_stop_marker
0x0201.notes: Seen only in POST .../pair when exiting/disabling pairing

0x025e.name: session_token
0x025e.notes: Observed length 8 bytes; mirrors CoAP option 2048

0x027a.name: dial_interaction_result
0x027a.notes: Dial interaction result/status. | Seen in: d/VA*/sen | Observed values: 0, 3 | Len: 1 bytes

0x027c.name: va_act_limit_high_steps
0x027c.notes: Piston fully retracted span limit steps

0x028d.name: va_act_status_flags_s16
0x028d.notes: Motor movement error and block bitmask

0x044c.name: ot_ch_flow_temperature
0x044c.notes: OpenTherm ID 18 (CH water temperature / flow). Encoded as centi-degC.

0x044d.name: ot_ch_return_temperature
0x044d.notes: OpenTherm ID 19 (CH return temperature). Encoded as centi-degC.

0x0450.name: ot_ch_control_setpoint
0x0450.notes: Most likely OpenTherm ID 1 (Control setpoint / target CH flow temp). Encoded as centi-degC.

0x0452.name: ot_relative_modulation_level
0x0452.notes: OpenTherm ID 14 Relative modulation level. Observed as integer percent

0x0457.name: boiler_active
0x0457.notes: Derived runtime flag. Correlates with modulation >0 and elevated flow temp; likely burner/heat-cycle active.

0x0458.name: hvac_status_or_fault_flags
0x0458.notes: Status/fault flags word. Often 0 during normal operation; may not be raw OpenTherm ID 0.

0x0481.name: hvac_field_presence_list
0x0481.notes: List of referenced FIDs with an attribute byte (seen attr=2). Likely supported/present/valid fields for this topic.

0x044e.name: ot_exhaust_temperature
0x044e.notes: OpenTherm flue exhaust gas temperature reading (Data ID 33)

0x044f.name: ot_outside_temperature
0x044f.notes: OpenTherm outside sensor temperature reading (Data ID 27)

0x045b.name: dhw_target_temperature
0x045b.notes: Domestic hot water target temperature (°C×100). | Seen in: h/*/hvac/mon/dhw | Len: 2 bytes

0x0460.name: hvac_water_pressure_mbar
0x0460.notes: Observed as 0xFFFFxxxx; low16 tracks plausible CH system pressure in mbar (e.g. 0x0529=1321mbar=1.321bar). High16 often 0xFFFF sentinel. Likely derived from OpenTherm Data-ID 18 (CH water pressure).

0x0463.name: ot_burner_start_count
0x0463.notes: OpenTherm-derived burner start counter (OT Data-ID ~116). Observed as 0x0000FFFF when not supported or unavailable.

0x0464.name: ot_ch_pump_start_count
0x0464.notes: OpenTherm-derived central-heating pump start counter (OT Data-ID ~117). Often reported as 0x0000FFFF (not available).

0x0465.name: ot_ch_burner_start_count
0x0465.notes: Derived central heating burner start counter (total burner starts - DHW burner starts)

0x0466.name: ot_burner_time_total
0x0466.notes: OpenTherm-derived total burner operation time. Observed divisible by 60; likely OT-hours * 60.

0x0467.name: ot_burner_time_ch
0x0467.notes: OpenTherm-derived burner operation time attributed to CH (space heating). 0x0466 = 0x0467 + 0x0468.

0x0468.name: ot_burner_time_dhw
0x0468.notes: OpenTherm-derived burner operation time attributed to DHW. 0x0466 = 0x0467 + 0x0468.

0x046c.name: ot_dhw_supported
0x046c.notes: HVAC config flag. | Seen in: h/*/hvac/config | Len: 1 bytes

0x046d.name: ot_dhw_not_supported
0x046d.notes: HVAC config flag. | Seen in: h/*/hvac/config | Len: 1 bytes

0x046f.name: dhw_setpoint
0x046f.notes: OpenTherm domestic hot water target setpoint (Data ID 57)

0x0471.name: dhw_setpoint_max
0x0471.notes: OpenTherm domestic hot water setpoint upper limit/boundary (Data ID 48)

0x2040.name: circuit_dhw_max_flow_temperature
0x2040.notes: DHW Max Flow Temperature | Len: 2 bytes

0x2090.name: circuit_mode_or_flags_2090
0x2090.notes: Circuit mode/flags. | Seen in: h/*/c/1/act | Observed values: 0, 1, 3, 4 | Len: 1 bytes | Bitfield/enum; observed values 0–4 in h/*/c/*/act.

0x4000.name: circuit_reference_temp
0x4000.notes: Circuit reference/measured room temperature used by controller. Typically below/around target when demand>0.

0x4040.name: circuit_target_temp
0x4040.notes: Circuit target temperature. | Seen in: h/*/c/1/act | Len: 2 bytes | Observed values in h/*/c/*/act consistent with target temp in cC.

0x4080.name: circuit_demand_percent
0x4080.notes: Circuit demand as percent. | Seen in: h/*/c/1/act | Len: 1 bytes | Observed values 0–100 in h/*/c/*/act consistent with demand/percent.

0x6040.name: zone_program_uri
0x6040.notes: CoAP URI for zone program endpoint (often /z/p)

0x6060.name: zone_program_enabled
0x6060.notes: Boolean flag related to zone program/schedule config

0x6080.name: zone_temperature_deviation_limit
0x6080.notes: Allowed deviation from baseline (±). Max likely baseline+this, min likely baseline-this (clamped by frost min). Observed 10.00°C.

0x60a0.name: zone_frost_min_temperature
0x60a0.notes: Hard minimum temperature floor for zone UI/control

0x60c0.name: zone_temperature_baseline
0x60c0.notes: Baseline/center temperature used for deriving allowed range

0x60e0.name: zone_open_window_detection_enabled
0x60e0.notes: Boolean flag. True if open window detection is enabled

0x6160.name: home_away
0x6160.notes: Seen in z/*/s. Flips to 2 on away-mode, back to 1 on home-mode.

0x61e0.name: zone_enabled
0x61e0.notes: Seen in z/*/s. 1 when zone active; 0 when zone inactive.

0x6240.name: overlay_mode
0x6240.notes: Seen in z/*/s. 0 during schedule. 2/3 when manual target set. Observed value 3 for DHW manual override states (incl. OFF+temp-null and temp override).

0x6280.name: overlay_target_temp
0x6280.notes: Dial-set target temperature sent via /overlay; value in centi-degrees C

0x62c0.name: zone_open_window_shutoff_duration
0x62c0.notes: Seconds to disable heating when open window is detected

0x62e0.name: overlay_active_aux
0x62e0.notes: Seen in z/*/s. Often 0 when schedule is active/no overlay. Changes when overlay is active; exact semantics still TBD.

0x6380.name: zone_program_time_step
0x6380.notes: Zone config constant. Likely schedule/program granularity enforced by devices.

0x63a0.name: zone_state_uri
0x63a0.notes: CoAP URI for zone state endpoint (often /z/s)

0x63e0.name: zone_peer_uris_enabled
0x63e0.notes: Zone config capability/presence flag. Appears alongside zone peer URI fields (state/program URIs).

0x6440.name: telemetry_config
0x6440.notes: Seen in PUT z/s immediately after pressing resume schedule

0x8000.name: zone_state_peer_uris
0x8000.notes: Repeated list of CoAP URIs pointing to /z/s on peers

0x8200.name: zone_cpe_peer_uris
0x8200.notes: Repeated list of CoAP URIs pointing to /z/cpe on peers

0x8400.name: zone_program_peer_uris
0x8400.notes: Repeated list of CoAP URIs pointing to /z/p on peers

0x01d1.name: neighbor_entry
0x01d1.notes: Neighbor entry sub-TLV. Contains type byte + 0x01d2 IPv6. Typically 19 bytes.

0x01d3.name: neighbor_data
0x01d3.notes: Neighbor link metrics/data. Variable length (20 or 39 bytes). Often all zeros when no data available.

0x02b3.name: device_config_flag_02b3
0x02b3.notes: Device config boolean flag. Observed always false in server-to-client config pushes.

0x0dd3.name: server_field_0dd3
0x0dd3.notes: Server-originated u8 field. Single occurrence with value 0xA3 (163). Purpose unknown.

0x0dd8.name: server_marker_0dd8
0x0dd8.notes: Server-originated empty marker. Single occurrence. Purpose unknown.

0x01d0.name: neighbor_self_ipv6
0x01d0.notes: Self IPv6 address in neighbor table. Always 16 bytes.

0x021a.name: device_config_aux_021a
0x021a.notes: Device config auxiliary field. Observed always 0 in server-to-client config pushes.

0x0d1c.name: server_marker_0d1c
0x0d1c.notes: Server-originated empty marker. Single occurrence. Purpose unknown.

0x0266.name: va_act_position2_steps_unused
0x0266.notes: Unused. VA uses 0x0294 for secondary position steps.

0x0283.name: va_act_status_flags_unused
0x0283.notes: Unused. VA uses 0x028d for actuator status/flags.

0x01d2.name: neighbor_ipv6
0x01d2.notes: Neighbor IPv6 address (used as sub-TLV inside 0x01d1)

0x6500.name: zone_param_kp
0x6500.notes: Proportional gain coefficient (Kp) for zone PID controller

0x6520.name: zone_param_ki
0x6520.notes: Integral gain coefficient (Ki) for zone PID controller

0x6540.name: zone_param_kd
0x6540.notes: Derivative gain coefficient (Kd) for zone PID controller

0x6560.name: zone_param_heating_curve
0x6560.notes: Heating curve index representing flow temp response

0x045a.name: ot_dhw_temperature
0x045a.notes: OpenTherm domestic hot water measured temperature

0x02b2.name: display_active_timeout
0x02b2.notes: Timeout duration for display activity/temporary overlay in minutes

0x045e.name: ot_dhw_flow_rate
0x045e.notes: OpenTherm ID 19 domestic hot water flow rate in litres per minute

0x0462.name: ot_ch_water_pressure_bar
0x0462.notes: OpenTherm ID 18 central heating system water pressure in bar
